summary: Maison Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a proposed settlement of a stockholder derivative action (In re Maison Solutions Inc. Derivative Litigation) in the Central District of California. The settlement requires the company to adopt and maintain corporate governance reforms for five years; no price per share or premium is involved. The company's insurer will pay $400,000 in plaintiffs' attorneys' fees and expenses, plus up to $3,000 service awards per plaintiff. A fairness hearing is set for August 12, 2026. Defendants deny wrongdoing. Watch for court approval; no risk-arb spread as this is a governance settlement, not an M&A transaction.
